title: Python Foundations
description: Start programming from zero: variables, loops, functions, files and testing, with small projects you finish in an afternoon.

title: Data Analysis with pandas
description: Clean, combine and summarise spreadsheets and CSV files with pandas, then turn them into clear charts for your team.

title: Machine Learning Essentials
description: Train and evaluate classic models such as regression, decision trees and clustering with scikit-learn, and learn when not to use them.

title: Generative AI for Developers
description: Build applications on large language models: APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, embeddings, RAG, agents, evaluation and production.

title: Prompt Engineering for Business Teams
description: No coding needed. Write clear instructions for chat assistants, reuse templates, and check AI answers before you trust them at work.

title: Building RAG Applications
description: Ground model answers in your own documents: chunking, vector search, hybrid retrieval, citations and measuring answer quality.

title: AI Agents in Production
description: Design agents that plan, call tools and ask a human for approval, with memory, guardrails, tracing and cost limits.

title: Computer Vision with Deep Learning
description: Teach software to understand pictures and video: image classification, object detection and multimodal models that read images.

title: AZ-900: Azure Fundamentals
description: Cloud concepts, core Azure services, pricing and support, preparing you for the AZ-900 certification exam. Exam voucher included.

title: AZ-104: Azure Administrator
description: Manage identities, storage, virtual networks and virtual machines in Azure. Prepares you for the AZ-104 exam. Exam voucher included.

title: AZ-305: Azure Solutions Architect
description: Design identity, data, compute and networking solutions on Azure, with reliability and cost trade-offs. Prepares you for AZ-305.

title: AI-102: Azure AI Engineer
description: Build solutions with Azure AI services and Microsoft Foundry: language, vision, search and generative AI. Prepares you for AI-102.

title: Kubernetes for Developers
description: Package applications in containers, deploy them to Kubernetes, and handle configuration, scaling and rolling updates.

title: Docker Quick Start
description: Build, run and share container images, write a Dockerfile, and run a small app with a database using Docker Compose.

title: DevOps with GitHub Actions
description: Automate build, test and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, including secrets, environments and approvals.

title: Secure Coding Fundamentals
description: Avoid the most common security mistakes in web apps: injection, broken authentication, secrets in code and unsafe dependencies.

title: SQL for Everyone
description: Query databases with SELECT, JOIN and GROUP BY, design simple tables and answer business questions from your data.

title: Data Engineering on Azure
description: Build batch and streaming data pipelines with Azure Data Factory, Spark and a lakehouse, and keep them reliable and cheap.

title: Responsible AI in Practice
description: Fairness, safety, privacy and transparency for AI products, with checklists and red-teaming exercises your team can reuse.

title: Speaking with Confidence for Tech Professionals
description: Explain technical ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues, run better demos and handle tough questions calmly.
